name: IIT Gandhinagar

about.text: Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IITGN) is one of the prominent institutions in India and all the IITs are globally recognized and renowned for their reputation and quality education. The IITGN Online is focused on imparting global competent education with a holistic approach in different specializations of engineering and technical fields.

IIT Gandhinagar Online is located in Palaj, Gandhinagar, Gujarat near the Sabarmati River and it was established in 2008. IIT Gandhinagar is also known as the cleanest IIT and it is the first institute-rated 5-star GRIHA LD (Green) campus, that minimized the negative impacts on the environment. Meanwhile, IITGN has been declared the first Indian 5-star campus that ensures food safety and promotes healthy eating.

IIT Gandhinagar takes all the precautions and follows all the guidelines implemented by the government to run an environment-friendly institution simultaneously IITGN Online takes care of its employees as well, so IITGN follows the highest standards of safety for its employees majority of those involved in the construction works. After considering the safety measures taken by the IITGN, labor welfare, and community outreach the IIT Council is to introduce this practice in all the IITs.

emi.text: There are various undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs offered at the IIT Gandhi Nagar Online in different specializations. The fee structure of every program is designed in such a way that every student and working professional can afford it. To financially assists students, the institute offers loan option and there are a few scholarship programs available as well which students can avail of according to their eligibility criteria. A few scholarships offered at the institute are:
Erach and Meheroo Mehta Merit Scholarship
Scholarship for Excellence in Sports and Games
Scholarship for Excellence in Arts & Culture

admission.text: Candidates are willing to enroll at the IIT Gandhi Nagar are requested to appear for entry-level exams like JEE (Joint Entrance Examination) for undergraduate programs and GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering) for postgraduate programs and other relevant exams IT JAM, CAT, CEED, & JRF. The admission to the IITs is based on the cut-off basis, after scoring minimum marks in these exams, candidates have to follow some basic steps mentioned below:
Step 1 Interested candidates have to visit the IIT Gandhi Nagar's official website and register on the website.
Step 2 After completion of the registration process, the candidate will receive their credentials to access the admission portal.
Step 3 After logging in to the admission portal, candidates have to click on the apply button and start filling out the application form.
Step 4 While filling out the application form candidates have to provide accurate information related to personnel details, education, and professional background.

Step 5 Meanwhile, candidates are also requested to attach the relevant documents along with the application form and make sure all the information and documents are accurate or the application may get rejected from the institution end.
Step 6 When all the steps in the application form are completed, the candidate can proceed with the payment process and then submit their application form.
Note - Students have to check the eligibility criteria of their opted program and it is mandatory to clear the applicable entrance exam if not, they continue the further process.

examination.text: The shortlisted students based on their entrance exam evaluation are allowed to start a fresh semester and the examinations at the institutes are primarily focused on enhancing the skills of an individual with the practical-based learning system. The institute upskills the students through regular research, workshops, self-analysis, and training sessions. This helps encourage the students to build industry-oriented abilities for quick and accurate decision-making and gives a boost to the morale of every individual. The exams are held in a semester pattern, which has two main components i.e. internal assessment and end-term examination. These examinations are conducted to evaluate the overall theoretical and practical understanding of a student throughout the program. For a brief understanding of the examination pattern section-wise, students can look for the previous year's question papers.

placementText.text: The dedicated placement department of IIT Gandhi Nagar Online remains active for every candidate throughout the program. The institute has partnered with some of the major leading companies and they actively recruit students from the institution. Some of the major recruiters of IIT Gandhi Nagar include Salesforce, Accenture, Cognizant, Deloitte, and Adobe. A few pros of IIT Gandhinagar placement cella are:
The average package offered at the institute varies from 15-19 LPA.
The median package offered at the institute has increased by 57% for BTech students and 30% for MTech students.
Last year 424 students were placed during the placement drive.

faqs.q: What is the highest package at IIT Gandhinagar?
faqs.a: The highest package offered at IIT Gandhinagar Online stands at INR 40 LPA.

faqs.q: Is it compulsory to stay in a hostel in IIT Gandhinagar?
faqs.a: No, taking hostel accommodation is totally up to the student and it is not mandatory to stay in a hotel only. Student can choose their off-campus accommodation as well.

faqs.q: What is the last date for IIT Gandhinagar admission 2026?
faqs.a: The last date to apply for IIT Gandhinagar Online is March 25, 2026, by 5 pm (Phase - II application deadline).

faqs.q: What programs are offered by IIT Gandhinagar?
faqs.a: The various programs offered at the IIT Gandhinagar are B.Tech, M.Tech, M.Sc., M.A., Ph.D., and Visiting Students Programme.
